subject: problems with listen parameter on noisew()

messages.author: e14cfb57d640984d
messages.subject: problems with listen parameter on noisew()
parts:
Hello,

I'm having trouble with the listen parameter on noisew(). Here is a mini-session:

> foo = noisew(44100, 1, output="Wave")   # works fine
> listen(foo)  # plays fine
> foo = noisew(44100, 1, output="Wave", listen=T)   # does not work!
Error in is.data.frame(wave) : object 'sound' not found

The listen parameter on synth() works fine though:

> foo = synth(44100, 1, 1000, output="Wave", listen=T)   # creates wav and plays it

I'm using R 2.15.0 on Windows, with seewave 1.6.3. I'm using sox "play.exe" as my sound player.

Thanks very much,
Jesse Ross

messages.author: 44c03a0165efd08f
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] problems with listen parameter on noisew()
parts:
If you search the list, I had a similar problem last year. I think it
has to do with interference between seewave and tuneR. I think I
figured out the problem by making sure I loaded the packages and
assigned the player in a particular order (tuneR, then seewave, then set
the player). Let me know if that helps.

Steffi
